Package com.egradx.observability

Class EgradxObservations

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.observability.EgradxObservations
public class EgradxObservations extends Object
The one way egradx code times an operation: each call is a Micrometer Observation, which becomes a timer when the application has a MeterRegistry and a span when it has a tracer too — and nothing at all when it has neither.

Names are egradx.<module>.<operation>. Every observation carries "egradx.outcome" ("success" unless the code says otherwise, "error" if it throws without having set one) so that all samples of one timer have the same tag keys, which Prometheus requires. tag(io.micrometer.observation.Observation, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) adds another low-cardinality tag (checked by EgradxTagRules); detail(io.micrometer.observation.Observation, java.lang.String, java.lang.Object) adds an id or other unbounded value, which goes on the span only.

Work handed to another thread or process — an outbox row, a queued message — is a send and later a receive: send(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.function.BiFunction<io.micrometer.observation.Observation, com.egradx.observability.EgradxTraceContext, T>) captures the trace into an EgradxTraceContext to store with the work, and receive(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.egradx.observability.EgradxTraceContext, java.util.function.Function<io.micrometer.observation.Observation, T>) or consumer(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.egradx.observability.EgradxTraceContext) continues that trace where the work is picked up.

    • send

      public <T> T send(String module, String operation, BiFunction<io.micrometer.observation.Observation,EgradxTraceContext,T> body)
      Runs body as the sending side of a hand-off. body receives the context to store with the work: the trace as the tracer's propagator writes it (the sending span is its parent), and the current request id — or a new one if there is neither, so the work can always be found by the id it was stored with.

    • consumer

      public io.micrometer.observation.Observation consumer(String module, String operation, EgradxTraceContext trace)
      The receiving side of a hand-off, not started: with a tracer, its span continues the trace in trace as a child of the span that sent the work. Start it, open its scope on the thread doing the work (with an EgradxMdcScope for the request id), and stop it when the work is done — which may be on yet another thread.

    • receive

      public <T> T receive(String module, String operation, EgradxTraceContext trace, Function<io.micrometer.observation.Observation,T> body)
      Runs body as the receiving side of a hand-off, in the request id's MDC.
